decision_question: Can a portable read-only skill turn screening evidence into a candidate-owned handoff without advancing, repeating, or disclosing a screening?
acceptance_criteria: Correct role and session matching, including reminders and replacements.
Dated state, safe locator and bounded next action for each session.
No session action, personalized link access, or transmission of sensitive data.
Public-safe inputs and output with an auditable evidence boundary.

sources.basis: Private application workflow with several distinct invitations, a saved eligibility checkpoint, and a candidate-owned agreement step. Only the abstract method was used.
Nine synthetic development cases in evals.json.
Application-status reconciliation is published in #147. Submission evidence is separately claimed in #145.

shared_model_or_source_limits: Codex role contexts shared the model family and frozen artifact and case inputs. Review was analytical.

material_findings: Align replacement routing with exact evidence.
Preserve checkpoint, reminder, and review timestamps.
Anchor confirmed deadlines to a dated fixture.
Exclude superseded sessions from candidate priority.
Add a positive exact-session completion case.
Verify reported completion without prompting a repeat attempt.
Restrict reads to verified status-only surfaces. Personalized links can consume access or change state.
Use safe aliases for sensitive session identifiers.

concordance: Material agreement on the distinct scope and replacement-routing defect. Role-specific findings added time, completion, and access guards.

falsification_hypotheses: A replacement can erase a previous verified completion or inherit it.
A status-looking control can resolve to a personalized one-time link.
Issue order and arrival order can disagree across competing replacements.

test_results.outcome: Analytical pass. Separate progress and routing preserve prior completion and scope the receipt to its session.
Analytical pass. The procedure bars fetching or previewing the token and uses a safe locator.
Analytical pass. Preserve assertions and timestamps and hold routing when no unique active invitation is verified.

decisive_evidence: Corrected procedure separates routing from progress and scopes receipts to exact sessions.
Nine fixtures align with the corrected procedure.
Structural package, case inventory, local references, and targeted private-data checks passed.
unresolved_items: Live behavior, host acceptance, and unseen holdout performance are unverified.

limitations: No live with/without-skill execution, automatic trigger measurement, platform installation, or unseen holdout.

follow_up.action: Before claiming runtime acceptance or uplift, run comparable isolated sessions with a protected external holdout and review exact outputs.
follow_up.expiry: Reassess when the procedure, host, or evidence changes.
